verdict_text: YES. The script computes `scale = lora_alpha / r = 2`, forms `B @ A` (`[2304, 768]`) and transposes it because `fan_in_fan_out` is true, giving `[768, 2304]`, then adds it to the base weight in float32 and casts back to the base dtype (also float32), leaving name, shape and dtype intact. Adapter tensors are read from a separate dict and never inserted into `sd`, so no adapter or intermediate tensor can reach the output, and all other base tensors are untouched. All four required checks — 12 merged pairs, no `lora_` names, `h.0.attn.c_attn.weight` shape `(768, 2304)`, and 160 tensors — are asserted before `save_sharded_safetensors` is called, and any missing adapter or base key would raise a `KeyError` first. Sharding is delegated with the required 104,857,600-byte budget.
